title: Director KYC (DIR-3 KYC)
question: What is DIR-3 KYC, and what if it is missed?

body.normal: Every person holding a Director Identification Number confirms their contact details and identity with the Ministry of Corporate Affairs once a year. That yearly confirmation is DIR-3 KYC.
body.simple: Each director confirms their details with the government once a year.
body.detail: The director confirms their mobile number, email and address. The first time it is a full form with documents; in later years it is usually a short web confirmation. It is a personal obligation of each director, across all companies they sit on.
body.why: A director whose DIN is deactivated cannot sign filings for any company until it is fixed.

facts.v: Yearly identity confirmation by each director
Each director; your firm helps with the filing
The director's DIN is deactivated until the KYC is filed with a late fee. Meanwhile they cannot sign company filings.

citations.label: Companies (Appointment and Qualification of Directors) Rules 2014, rule 12A
